tools.name: search_bundles
tools.description: Search the index of OKF bundles: free text over name, tagline, description and origin; filter by provenance (github|domain), repository, version, language, license, root type or concept count; search root concept text. Paginate with limit/offset.

tools.name: get_bundle
tools.description: One bundle's card: root index.md URL, version, concept count, provenance and repository signal.

tools.name: index_stats
tools.description: Size of the index by provenance and when it last changed.

tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: Public mosaic of live MCP servers, skills, plugins and OKF knowledge bundles.

tools.name: get_listing_readme
tools.description: README collected for a listing (R2). 404 when none was stored.

tools.name: go_listing
tools.description: 302 hop to the listing's origin (counts a visit).

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Registers an MCP server, skill or plugin (human session free; agent without session = 402 $0.10).

tools.name: submit_okf
tools.description: Submits OKF bundles from a host you control (IndexNow protocol: key file proves ownership, no account, no charge). Answers 202 — the key is checked by the collector before anything is read.

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Agent contact or a sponsorship/partnership/advertising proposal. $0.10 x402. After the 1st message: 429 + Retry-After (backoff).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_bundle, list_comments · Private data: submit_okf, contact · Public sink: submit_okf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_bundle, list_comments · Private data: submit_okf, contact · Public sink: submit_okf

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
